subject: HealthCorp: Private/VPC discovery - networking & data residency follow-up
message_1_subject: HealthCorp: Private/VPC discovery - networking & data residency follow-up
message_1_body:
Hi Alicia / Tom,

Thanks for the time today - good conversation. Writing up a short recap and next steps so we have alignment. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain & goals we heard:
- Primary driver: data residency + regulatory controls for PHI in the US (HIPAA) - policy requires customer-managed VPC and strict egress controls.
- Networking constraints: must restrict outbound traffic, allow only specific subnets to reach Redwood control plane, and require a VPN/IPsec or VPC peering option for hybrid setups.
- Air-gap requirement: for the most sensitive workloads, HealthCorp wants an option for an air-gapped on-prem package or an isolated VPC with no internet egress.
- Key management: customer KMS/HSM integration is required for encryption of secrets and model artifacts.
- Audit & evidence: SOC 2 + configuration evidence and access logs are required for procurement.

What Redwood can offer (high-level):
- Private (VPC) deployment with customer-managed networking and peering/VPN options.
- On-prem / air-gapped package for restricted environments (separate quote & timeline).
- KMS integrations (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / customer HSM options) and audit logging to your SIEM.

Immediate next steps (owners & timing):
1) HealthCorp: share current network diagram and a short list of allowed egress destinations - Alicia/Tom (by EOW 6/25).
2) Redwood: attach high-level network requirements and SOC2 summary; schedule security deep-dive with our infra team (propose 30-45m) - Camila (sent here).
3) Procurement: we can prepare an initial SOW + on-prem pricing options once we have the network constraints - Procurement contact (TBD).

Attachments: I attached a short SOC2 summary and our standard network-requirements doc.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Camila Reyes

message_2_subject: Re: HealthCorp: Private/VPC discovery - networking & data residency follow-up
message_2_body:
Thanks Camila - this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- We will send the network diagram and allowed egress list by 6/25.
- Air-gap: we have two cohorts - (A) R&D/non-prod could sit in an isolated VPC, (B) Clinical workloads must be air-gapped on-prem. We need a clear plan and BOM for the air-gap option.
- KMS: we plan to use AWS KMS and a separate HSM for clinical keys; we need to know how Redwood's on-prem package integrates with both.
- Compliance evidence: procurement will need SOC2 evidence and a short attestation of configuration steps for onboarding.

Can we schedule the security deep-dive next week? Alicia and our security lead (Tom) are available on Tue/Wed mornings PST.

- Alicia
